verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships its own server mode (`llama serve`) with a built-in web UI, which is the core serving capability. The pack never documents binding to a network interface or reaching the server from other devices on a LAN, so the local-network part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of host/port binding for LAN access, evidence of access from other devices, any API or auth details, independent hands-on corroboration of network serving.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can serve models over my local network for access from other devices

citations.quote: Built-in web UI against `llama serve` running Qwen 3.6
